en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing an industrial riverside cityscape with factory buildings and tall chimneys along rapids. In the foreground are large brick mill complexes on both riverbanks, with water flowing through dams or sluices. In the distance a church tower and other city buildings are visible. The lower part of the card is filled with handwritten text, and printed in red is the caption identifying the place.
